implementation_notes: Modules are namespaces plus headers; pimpl gives compile-time coupling reduction at the cost of an indirection per call. Keep the interface class free of data, put the change-prone implementation behind pimpl, and export one umbrella header.
idiom_name: pimpl for the change-prone secret + narrow interface header
pitfalls: Pimpl paid for a secret that never changes
Templates in headers force recompilation of every client on every edit
